messages:
Iris K: Heads-up — release/v0.44.0 blocked: changelog validation failed because no fragment was created. release-bot says regendiff failed.

release-bot: aborting changelog fragment creation: regendiff check returned non-zero. No fragment opened.

Tom B: I think this happened because someone pushed a semver bump before running `yarn regen`. The regendiff is only an ordering change in generated types (no behavioral change).

Iris K: Can someone add a short fragment to unblock while we fix the regendiff noise? Minimal fragment okay.

Sam P: I'll add fragment and regen locally. Steps I'll take:
```bash
yarn install && yarn regen || true
# commit any regressions if safe
git commit -am "chore(typegen): regen for v0.44.0" || true
echo "- devex: add missing changelog fragment for v0.44.0" > changelog/fragments/0003.md
git add changelog/fragments/0003.md && git commit -m "chore(release): fragment for v0.44.0" && git push origin release/v0.44.0
```

Tom B: Note: sample-app auth/retry tests have been flaky on the release runners recently; if CI flakes we may re-block. Suggest running `yarn test:sample-app --runInBand` locally.

Iris K: Follow-up action items: (1) change release-bot to attach regendiff summary when it aborts (so authors know what to regen), (2) add a small whitelist for regen-only diffs where bot can still open a draft fragment, (3) add a single-retry for flaky sample-app tests in publish pipeline. I'll file an RFC.

ci-bot: publish pipeline re-triggered by push from Sam P. Typegen/regendiff passed; sample-app tests passed on retry. Publish completed.

Iris K: Thanks all. RFC incoming. :thumbsup:
